analysis.summary: Artyom Morozov and Alizhan Muratov discuss their training, recovery, and upcoming matches, with Morozov providing specific updates on his right-hand strength and body weight.
analysis.popular_take: Artyom Morozov is returning to the right-hand elite in peak condition, weighing 140kg and claiming his hand strength, specifically his rising, is better than ever post-surgery.
analysis.counter_case: While Morozov feels stronger, he admits he hasn't yet tested his absolute maximum ('peaked out') since his surgery, leaving some uncertainty about his top-end power against someone like Ermes.

claims.claim: Morozov's right arm is feeling better every day and is recovering well.
claims.relevance: Crucial for assessing his readiness for a high-intensity right-hand match against Ermes.

claims.claim: Morozov is utilizing IVs and intensive training protocols for this preparation.
claims.relevance: Indicates a high level of professional preparation and physical investment.

claims.claim: Post-surgery, Morozov's 'rising' strength on his right hand does not drop or fatigue as it did before.
claims.relevance: Rising is a key defensive and offensive component against Ermes' top-roll.

claims.claim: Morozov feels he has more 'reserve' strength now than he had previously.
claims.relevance: Suggests a higher ceiling for his right-hand performance compared to his pre-injury form.
Significant mass increase which usually correlates to increased raw power in the super-heavyweight division.

claims.claim: Morozov believes he will be even stronger when he officially 'peaks' for the match.
claims.relevance: Suggests the 140kg version seen now is not yet his final form for the Ermes match.

analysis.key_question: Will Morozov's reported increase in 'rising' stability and 140kg frame be enough to stop Ermes Gasparini's world-class transition from a hit to a press?
notes: Morozov is very confident about his right hand's structural integrity post-surgery.
The weight update (140kg) is a major data point for fans comparing him to Ermes' similar frame.

source.title: ARTYOM MOROZOV & ALIZHAN MURATOV | EVW 23 LIVESTREAM
